questions.question: What did the Teacher say he had seen happen to a righteous man in his futile life?

answers.text: He lived long in his righteousness
He was honored by every king

questions.question: What did the Teacher warn could happen to someone who is excessively wicked or a fool?

answers.text: They could die before their time
They could be driven from the city

questions.question: The Teacher said there is no righteous man on earth who does good and never sins. True or false?
The Teacher said God made mankind upright. What did mankind do instead?

answers.text: They were led astray by kings
They grew tired of doing good
